premises.text: Building products means nothing if they're not the right products
premises.evidence_span: building products means nothing if they're not the right products

premises.text: Product managers struggle to get feedback stored in various systems
premises.evidence_span: we product managers still try to get to feedback that is stored in a variety of systems

premises.text: Current tools are optimized for product delivery, not product discovery
premises.evidence_span: we are stuck with tools that are optimized and designed for product delivery, not the crucial part of product discovery

premises.text: Feedback is hoarded in various systems and formats
premises.evidence_span: we hoard feedback in a variety of systems, records and formats

premises.text: Efforts to understand user needs often fail, leading to wasted energy on unwanted features
premises.evidence_span: despite this immense effort, we still fail to understand user needs and we end up wasting energy, building features and products that nobody wants

premises.text: Product Board helps product managers understand needs and prioritize what to build
premises.evidence_span: Product Board is a system of record for product management that helps product people understand what people need, prioritize what to build

premises.text: Product Board integrates feedback from multiple sources into one place
premises.evidence_span: thanks to the host of integrations, you've got here support tickets from Zendesk, conversations from Intercom, emails with user feedback, and even notes from user interviews

premises.text: Product Board allows linking user insights to feature ideas
premises.evidence_span: you can just highlight it, indicate how important it is to Sam. And now you can link it to a relevant feature idea

premises.text: Product Board organizes feature ideas by actual user needs
premises.evidence_span: this is organized by the actual user needs to help you focus on why a feature idea is important

premises.text: Product Board generates shareable roadmaps with underlying insights
premises.evidence_span: Auto-generated and shareable with all the underlying insights and information behind it

premises.text: Product Board keeps users updated on progress in real time
premises.evidence_span: Product board will keep you updated here in real time on the progress

premises.text: Product Board is a tool for everyone involved in product management
premises.evidence_span: this isn't just a tool for product managers, because at a typical product company, everyone wants to contribute and be part of the product management process

premises.text: Product Board creates a new market category for product discovery
premises.evidence_span: this is a whole new market category

premises.text: Product Board offers a subscription service with tiered pricing
premises.evidence_span: We offer a subscription service with a per-user tiered pricing, starting at $24 a month

premises.text: Product Board has acquired over 100 paying companies during beta
premises.evidence_span: we've acquired already over 100 paying companies, primarily driven by word of mouth

value.text: Product Board helps create products that people want
value.evidence_span: help you make products people want

notes: Demo details and specific customer acquisition methods are excluded as traction.
